application_credentials.description: Add your Omni Sync Server account. Enter your **sync username** as the *Client ID* and your **sync password** as the *Client secret*. These are not OAuth credentials; Home Assistant is only used as a secure vault. See [the documentation]({more_info_url}).

user.title: Connect to OmniFocus
user.description: Signing in with the stored credential for: **{accounts}**.\n\nTwo different secrets are involved: the credential's *client secret* is your Omni Sync Server **account password** (used to log in), while the *encryption passphrase* below only unlocks your data. Leave the passphrase empty if it is the same as your password.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with OmniFocus
reauth_confirm.description: Re-checking the credential for: **{accounts}**. If your sync password changed, update it under *Application credentials* first. Enter the encryption passphrase only if it differs from your account password.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Omni Sync Server.
error.invalid_auth: The Omni Sync Server rejected the login. Check the stored credential: the client ID must be your sync account name and the client secret your account **password** (not the encryption passphrase). Details are in the Home Assistant log.
error.invalid_passphrase: Logged in, but this encryption passphrase did not unlock your database. It is the passphrase chosen when OmniFocus sync encryption was set up, which can differ from your sync password (for example an older password). Details are in the Home Assistant log.
error.unknown: Unexpected error; see the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This OmniFocus account is already configured.
abort.missing_credentials: Add your Omni Sync Server account under Settings > Application credentials first.

user.title: Map a to-do list
user.description: Each Home Assistant to-do list maps to exactly one OmniFocus inbox, project or perspective. Lists default to read-only.

perspective.title: Choose perspective
perspective.description: Perspective support is best-effort: custom perspective rules are evaluated by Home Assistant, and items cannot be added to a perspective.

error.already_mapped: That OmniFocus source is already mapped to another to-do list.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The OmniFocus account must be loaded before adding lists.
abort.no_projects: No active projects were found in OmniFocus.
abort.no_perspectives: No custom perspectives were found in OmniFocus.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to check the sync server for changes, in seconds.

read_only.message: This to-do list is read-only. Change its mode to read / write to edit it.

not_found.message: That item no longer exists in OmniFocus.
